standard_prerequisites.use: Provides (a/b)^n as the local generator of O_W(nd) on D_+(ab).

core_obligations: Check on each D_+(ab) inside W with deg(a) = deg(b) + d: the restriction of s corresponds to the displayed fraction f/1 = b^n f/a^n (a/b)^n.
Since (a/b)^n generates the twist there, W_s intersect D_+(ab) is the principal open of b^n f/a^n.
The chart opens form a basis, so W_s = D_+(f) intersect W.
proof_roadmap: Restrict the section to each chart, identify the fraction, read off the principal open, and conclude by the basis.
difficulty_reason: Local computation on chart opens with the displayed section identification; fully displayed.
